'''Than Droe''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Druckenwell/Legends|Druckenwell]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He served as the leader of a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]]-aligned cell that operated on the world and in c. [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], he initiated a plan to have members of his cell destroy a Republic [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|''Acclamator''-class assault ship]] that was orbiting Druckenwell.
